name: HSD 2 - Customer reply to job card

nodes.name: Respond OK
nodes.notes: Answers the phone company at once. Everything after this runs in the background.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: Per-client settings. smsMode: mock or twilio. Slack and mock URLs are set here too. allowTestClock is for tests only: leave it false.

nodes.name: Add Row (mock CSV)
nodes.notes: Demo jobs sheet: a CSV file. Same columns as the Google Sheets node.

nodes.name: Add Row (Google Sheets)
nodes.notes: Turned off in the demo (no credentials). To go live: add the client's Google credential and pick the sheet.

nodes.name: Post to Slack
nodes.notes: Slack incoming webhook. Demo default is a local mock; put the client's real URL in Config.

nodes.name: Send SMS (Twilio)
nodes.notes: Turned off in the demo (no credentials). To go live: add the client's Twilio credential, turn this on, set smsMode to twilio.

nodes.name: Send SMS (mock)
nodes.notes: Demo sender: appends the text to a local log instead of sending it.

parameters.content:
## 2. Customer reply -> job card
The customer's text comes in. Plain rules read the address, ZIP and problem, flag urgent jobs and remember the customer for 24 hours. A job card goes to Slack and to the jobs sheet. A missing address gets a polite question instead of a card (unless it is urgent).
